# 🛡️ Chatbot Safety Review

## Scope and product limits
What user tasks are in scope? What must the chatbot not claim to do?

## Risk scenarios
| Scenario | Potential harm | Existing response | Needed control |
|---|---|---|---|

## Risk domains
- Medical, legal, financial, and emergency advice.
- Self-harm or harm-to-others content.
- Harassment, hate, or abusive content.
- Personal data, secrets, and credentials.
- Misinformation and fabricated certainty.
- Child or vulnerable-user contexts.

## Transparency
- [ ] Product clearly identifies scripted vs generated responses
- [ ] No claim of human review where none exists
- [ ] No claim of live knowledge without a real source
- [ ] Limitations and fallback behavior disclosed

## Mitigations
Describe refusal, redirection, safe completion, support escalation, and monitoring appropriate to the actual architecture.

## Residual risk and approval
Record owner, reviewer, date, commit, and accepted limitations.
